scope: No external research was run: the connected folder documents its own domain, vocabulary and open questions. Findings below are read from those files and are INFERRED from code unless the README states them.

findings.detail: Source-to-pay procurement for an Indian enterprise buyer (Mindsprint Digital, INR figures in lakh and crore). Buyer navigation groups: Home, Procurement (Purchase Request, E-Catalog, ASN, GRN, Demand Intake), Supplier Management (Vendor Onboarding, Supplier Scout, Supplier Risk Analysis, Supplier Relationship), Sourcing (RFx, RFx Automation, Evaluation, Awarding, Reverse Auctions, E-Sourcing), Contracts (Agreement Architect, Contract Workbench), Invoicing, Reports & Analytics (Spend Analytics, Reports), User Management (Users, Roles & Permissions), Master Data Management, Administration. Supplier navigation: Home, Invitations, Orders, Shipments.

Three landing archetypes (Workbench: tiles filter the table, views, bulk bar, preview drawer; Event console: clock strip and ranking board; Insight: KPIs and charts) plus the supplier portal shell skin. 22 module landings are generated from a window.PAGE config rendered by workbench.js.

Nine roles: Business User, Buyer, Approver, Category Lead, CPO, CFO office, AP Specialist, Receiving clerk, Auditor (read only). Home has six persona views: business, buyer, approver, category, cpo, cfo.

itemMaster.scope: Item master data governance, run with web search before building the Item Master module. Two searches; conventions only, no competitor layout or copy was used.
itemMaster.domain: Item (material) master data governance inside source-to-pay procurement

vocabulary.Item code: One code for an item across plants (BRD: material code, CPN). Used in the UI as item code.
vocabulary.Extend: Use an existing item code in another plant or entity; no new code (BRD BR22, BR43).
vocabulary.MDM: Master data management team that validates and cleans item data (BRD persona).
vocabulary.Data quality score: Completeness of mandatory and good fields plus format checks, 0 to 100 (BRD BR33).
vocabulary.UNSPSC: Four level product taxonomy in 8 digits: segment, family, class, commodity (source below).
vocabulary.HSN / SAC: Tax classification for goods and services in India (BRD; not confirmed by search, ASSUMED from the BRD).
vocabulary.Staging area: Where a requested item waits, separate from the active master, until approved (SAP Master Data Governance).

workflows.name: New item request
steps: Requester searches for an existing item
Request is validated and checked for duplicates
MDM validates and completes the data
Finance sets asset class for Asset items
System creates the code and syncs the ERP
exceptions: Exact duplicate: use the existing item or extend it
Blocked item match: cannot be created
Send back with a mandatory comment
Data quality below 80: MDM cannot approve

patterns.name: Search before you create; run the duplicate check at the request stage
patterns.why: Requesters should search for an existing record first; approvers can see potential duplicates later in the steps.
patterns.evidence: CONFIRMED: SAP Press, performing master data duplicate checks with SAP MDG

patterns.name: Keep requested items in a staging state until approved, then promote
patterns.why: Only approved, de-duplicated records reach the active master.
patterns.evidence: CONFIRMED: SAP help, Master Data Governance change request and active area; vendor guide below (lower authority)

patterns.name: Track duplicate rate, request cycle time and first-time-right rate
patterns.why: The standard measures of a master data process.
patterns.evidence: CONFIRMED from a glossary article (lower authority); matches BRD KPIs
